description: GitHub-side desired state for a repository implementing CDA Repository Baseline v1 + CDA npm Library Profile v1. This file is an OVERLAY on profiles/repository-baseline.json (see 'extends'), not a duplicate of it -- every field the npm Library Profile does not need to change from the baseline (repository settings, Actions permissions, core ruleset shape, secret-scanning/push-protection/vulnerability-alert toggles) is inherited unchanged; only this profile's own genuinely npm/JS-specific additions are declared here (CodeQL's applicable languages, and the npm publishing note). Package/build systems, workflow file contents, and other repository files belong to a template (e.g. template-npm-library), not to this profile. See docs/profiles.md and src/common/profile/ProfileLoader.psm1's Get-EffectiveCdaProfile for how this overlay is resolved.

npm.trustedPublisher: EXTERNAL SETUP REQUIRED - not managed by this provisioner version
